verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
trs.22: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn<sup foot_note=155010>1</sup> listened (to this Qur’ân). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ân)!

verses.text_uthmani: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا

trs.20: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
trs.85: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
trs.22: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
trs.203: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

trs.20: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
trs.85: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
trs.22: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
trs.203: ‘And He, exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children).<sup foot_note=155011>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا

trs.20: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees]<sup foot_note=197624>1</sup> has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
trs.85: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
trs.22: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
trs.203: ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblîs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allâh that which was an enormity in falsehood.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا

trs.20: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
trs.85: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
trs.22: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
trs.203: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allâh.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

trs.20: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
trs.85: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
trs.22: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
trs.203: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and transgression.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا

trs.20: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
trs.85: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
trs.22: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
trs.203: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allâh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

trs.20: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
trs.85: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
trs.22: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
trs.203: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

trs.20: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,<sup foot_note=197625>1</sup> but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
trs.85: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
trs.22: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
trs.203: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

trs.20: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
trs.85: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
trs.22: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
trs.203: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا

trs.20: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.<sup foot_note=197626>1</sup>
trs.85: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
trs.22: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
trs.203: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا

trs.20: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
trs.85: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
trs.22: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
trs.203: ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allâh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

trs.20: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.<sup foot_note=197627>1</sup>
trs.85: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
trs.22: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
trs.203: ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ân), we believed therein (Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا

trs.20: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.<sup foot_note=197628>1</sup> And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
trs.85: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
trs.22: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
trs.203: ‘And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allâh, after listening to this Qur’ân), and of us some are Al-Qâsitûn (disbelievers - those who have deviated from the Right Path)’. And whosoever has embraced Islâm (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allâh), then such have sought the Right Path."

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

trs.20: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
trs.85: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
trs.22: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
trs.203: And as for the Qâsitûn (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا

trs.20: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
trs.85: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
trs.22: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
trs.203: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allâh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islâm) We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.

translation.text: surely We (would) have given them to drink

verses.text_uthmani: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

trs.20: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord<sup foot_note=197629>1</sup> He will put into arduous punishment.
trs.85: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
trs.22: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
trs.203: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ân, - and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا

trs.20: And [He revealed] that the masjids<sup foot_note=197631>1</sup> are for Allāh, so do not invoke<sup foot_note=197630>2</sup> with Allāh anyone.
trs.85: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
trs.22: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
trs.203: And the mosques are for Allâh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allâh.<sup foot_note=155012>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

trs.20: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."<sup foot_note=197632>1</sup>
trs.85: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
trs.22: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
trs.203: And when the slave of Allâh (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) stood up invoking Him (his Lord - Allâh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation).

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
trs.85: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
trs.22: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I invoke only my Lord (Allâh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

trs.20: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
trs.85: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
trs.22: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
trs.203: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

trs.20: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
trs.85: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
trs.22: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "None can protect me from Allâh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

trs.20: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
trs.85: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
trs.22: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
trs.203: "(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allâh and His Messages (of Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."<sup foot_note=155013>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

trs.20: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
trs.85: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
trs.22: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
trs.203: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا

trs.20: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
trs.85: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
trs.22: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

verses.text_uthmani: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

trs.20: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
trs.85: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
trs.22: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
trs.203: "(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen)."

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا

trs.20: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers<sup foot_note=197633>1</sup>
trs.85: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
trs.22: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
trs.203: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.

verses.text_uthmani: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

trs.20: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know<sup foot_note=197634>1</sup> that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
trs.85: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
trs.22: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
trs.203: [He (Allâh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allâh). And He (Allâh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allâh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).
